name: THE BOUNTIFUL NUGGET
note: Doc 05 Room 3 plus doc 16, verbatim. Twelve hotspots and two exits. THE HANDBILL is the Rules of the Assay and carries Rule 3. THE PATRONS has no drawn figures in the background -- doc 07's ambient characters supply them at runtime, so the rect covers where they stand. Doc 16 note 4: the stove's third LISTEN reverses the first two on purpose; it has gone out and nobody has noticed. Do not 'correct' it.

idles.note: Errata ruling 20: a drawn crowd of four or more needs at least three animated members, and the eye gives the rest the credit. Four here, of eleven. Two-frame idles, not walk cycles -- a weight shift and a lifted glass. Rates 0.3-0.8 Hz, none of them equal, and each phase-offset, because three figures moving on the same beat is worse than none. THE MAN ON THE LANDING IS NOT IN THIS LIST AND MUST NEVER BE. Ruling 20 makes him an explicit exception: his entire joke is that he never moves, and in a room where four others shift he becomes conspicuous, which is the intent.

figures.note: At the bar, near end. Weight shift.
At the bar, middle. Lifts a glass.
Seated at the far table. Leans back.
Doc 16's man beside the stove, who has not taken his coat off. Shifts.

LOOK_AT.say: RULES OF THE ASSAY. One: a man may not be interrupted in his account. Two: a man's account may be doubted only by a better one. Three: truth is admissible but has never been raised. Four: the judges' decision is final and may be appealed to the same judges. Five: no firearms, no knives, no arithmetic.
repeat: I have read it twice. Rule five forbids arithmetic, which I assume has a history.
Rule four permits an appeal to the same judges who made the decision. Somebody thought about that and wrote it down anyway.

LISTEN_TO.say: Paper. It has been on this wall a long time. It has stopped being read.
repeat: Paper. Still not being read.
Nothing. It has outlasted everyone who nailed it up.

overrides.PICK_UP: It has been nailed on. Thoroughly. Somebody wanted the rules to stay up.

LOOK_AT.say: A hand of cards, face up, abandoned. It is a very good hand. Somebody left a very good hand on a table and went outside.
repeat: Still there. Nobody has claimed it and nobody has cleared it.
I have decided he is coming back. I have decided this several times.
Nothing.
Nothing. Whoever he was, he is not in the building.

overrides.USE: I do not play. My father was very clear about it, and he was wrong about most things.

LOOK_AT.say: An upright, hauled four hundred miles by mule, at a cost exceeding its value by an order of magnitude. Nobody here can play it.
repeat: Nobody has touched it since I arrived. I check.
There is a bottle ring on the lid. Several. It is being used as furniture.

LISTEN_TO.say: C-sharp is a semitone flat and has been for years. Nobody has noticed. I have made a note of it. I have made several notes of it.
repeat: Still C-sharp. Still flat. Still nobody.
I could put it right in four minutes, and I have begun to think about it during other activities.

overrides.USE: I could tune it. Nobody has asked me, and I have decided that asking to be asked is beneath me.
overrides.OPEN: The lid comes up. Inside is a piano, which is what I expected and somehow still a disappointment.

LOOK_AT.say: A chandelier. Below it, a dirt floor. The two have never been introduced.
repeat: Brass, crystal, and a dirt floor. Somebody made a decision about priorities and I should like to meet them.
It is not lit. It has never been lit while I have been in this room.

LISTEN_TO.say: It ticks as it cools. It is the most expensive object in the territory and it is hanging over mud.
repeat: Ticking as it cools. Still hanging over mud.
Nothing. It is the most expensive object in the territory and it has nothing to say for itself.

overrides.PULL: It is nine feet up and it weighs more than I do. I shall admire it from here.

LOOK_AT.say: I look like a man who has recently been robbed and is being brave about it.
repeat: Still me. I had hoped for some improvement.
Eleven weeks, and I have started to look like I belong here, which was not the plan.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. Mirrors are silent, which is the only restraint they show.
repeat: Still nothing.
Nothing. I keep checking. It keeps not.

LOOK_AT.say: Mahogany. Genuinely. Somebody spent real money on the one surface everyone leans on.
repeat: Mahogany. Four hundred miles from a tree that could have produced it.
The only maintained surface in Consolation, and it is a bar.

LISTEN_TO.say: Glasses. Talk. Somebody in the corner has told the same story four times and it has grown twice.
repeat: Glasses. Talk. The same story, larger.
Somebody is being served ahead of somebody else and it is being noticed.

overrides.PUSH: It does not move. It is the only thing in Consolation built to stay.

LOOK_AT.say: Stairs, up to rooms I have not been invited to. There is a man on the landing. There is always a man on the landing.
repeat: He has not moved. I have begun to suspect he is not waiting for anything.
Eleven steps. I have counted them from down here, which is as far as I have got.

LISTEN_TO.say: Boards, above. Somebody pacing a room about the size of mine.
repeat: Still pacing.
He has stopped. That is somehow worse.

overrides.USE: I have not been invited up and I am not going to invite myself.

LOOK_AT.say: A portrait of a man in a good collar, hung crooked, above a saloon. Nobody in here knows who he is. I have asked three people and had three answers.
repeat: The three answers were a governor, a founder, and 'that's Bill's uncle.'
It is the same photograph the Clarion prints as Obadiah Mott. I am fairly sure. I am not going to raise it.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. He has been silent about it for years.
repeat: Nothing.
Nothing. He is a man in Ohio and nobody is asking him.

LOOK_AT.say: A spittoon, positioned optimistically far from anyone sitting down.
repeat: The floor around it tells the story of a town that has tried.
Brass. Somebody polished this once, as a joke or as a duty.
Still yes.
I have stopped.

LOOK_AT.say: A cast iron stove, lit, in July. Nobody has raised it and I am not going to be the first.
repeat: Still lit. There is a man beside it who has not taken his coat off since I arrived in this territory.
The warmest thing in Consolation, wasted on a room full of men who are already drinking.

LISTEN_TO.say: It ticks. It is the only object in this room doing honest work.
repeat: Ticking. Working.
Nothing. It has gone out and nobody has noticed.

overrides.OPEN: It is lit. I am not opening a lit stove in a wooden building full of drunk men.

LOOK_AT.say: A window onto Main Street, and the cleanest thing in the building, because it is the only thing anyone in here looks at.
repeat: From in here the street looks better. That is what a window is for.
Somebody has scratched a name into the pane. It is not a name I know.

LISTEN_TO.say: The street. Muffled. Somebody arguing about a boundary.
repeat: Still the boundary. Still arguing.
The stage has come in. Four days from Sacramento and eleven new men who think they are early.

LOOK_AT.say: Eleven men drinking at eleven in the morning, all of whom will be at their claims by two and back here by five.
repeat: The same eleven. I have started to be able to tell them apart, which I regard as a poor sign.
Nobody in here is talking about anything but where the gold is. They have been having this conversation for twelve years and it has not advanced.

LISTEN_TO.say: Talk. A great deal of it, all at the same volume, none of it listened to.
repeat: Somebody in the corner has told the same story four times and it has grown twice.
The word 'Mott' comes up about once a minute. I have counted. It is once a minute.

overrides.TALK_TO: I have tried. They are very friendly, and they want to know what I know, and I know nothing, and this disappoints them each time.

LOOK_AT.say: Batwing doors, from the inside. They swing both ways, which from in here reads as a warning rather than a convenience.
repeat: Daylight past them. It is always a surprise.
Six inches of boardwalk and then the mud. I know exactly how far it is now.

LISTEN_TO.say: The street. It sounds busier from in here than it is.
repeat: Boots on the boardwalk. Somebody deciding whether to come in.
Nothing. Everyone who is coming in is in.

LOOK_AT.say: A door behind the bar, shut. There is a room back there and things are settled in it.
repeat: Shut. It has been shut every time I have looked, which is not the same as locked.
A door behind the bar. Shut, and shut in a way that has been decided rather than just closed.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. Whatever happens back there happens quietly, and then everyone agrees about it.
repeat: A pencil. Somebody is writing something down.
Two men going in. A little later, two men coming out, and one of the two is pleased.

overrides.PUSH: It gives half an inch and stops. Somebody has a chair against it.
